'''TJ Willard Luke!?Luuke!?!?!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] GeoCities site.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TJ Willard]]
* '''Published:''' by 9 July 2000 (Corellian Engineering Corporation)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Luke!?Luuke!?!?!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor MWYHL Willard LS 2000 CEC.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

It's best to train dos and give luke a cape. Give Chewie his bowcaster and a cape that way everyone has immunity to some attrition. With this deck use surprise assault 'cause if ya got reflection out you can get it back. If not then you got the immediatly retreive 10 force. AFA is good. that's 20 cards gone if ya use 'em all. and stone pile adds 4 more if you get both of them out. Every thing is pretty much self explainatory.
